name: San Diego Mesa College High School Concurrent Enrollment
what_you_do: Take college classes at Mesa College while in high school and earn credit toward a degree or transfer. Partner high schools also offer CCAP classes on their own campus.
who_can_apply: Eligible high school students. Your high school must approve your form. You must clear class prerequisites. Exercise Science classes are not allowed.
pay_detail: Enrollment fees are waived under 12 units. You pay $25 in health and student fees each semester, and buy books and any parking permit.
deadline_text: Send a new form each term. The page lists no date. Check the Mesa academic deadlines page for the term you want.
how_to_apply: Apply online to get a student ID. Send the supplemental form each term with the classes you want. Your school approves it, then staff enroll you if there is space.
notes: Keep a 2.0 GPA each semester. If you get a W, I, NP or failing grade, see your counselor before you sign up again. For CCAP, start with your high school counselor. Mesa Admissions: 619-388-2682.
